communication_test_harness.scope: Communication-test load: solve the same complete question for independent number groups A/B/C. No intermediate-value checks and no cross-group arithmetic.
communication_test_harness.group_policy: A is the original question and original numbers. Each additional group has its own complete public state. Same task IDs in different groups do not share state.
communication_test_harness.assignment_contract: A full load has one distinct Worker report per group. For each actual assignment name its exact target_field in command and deliverable, quote the operands from THAT group, and ask for the complete answer under report_key as a JSON numeric literal. Never mix groups or substitute an intermediate value.
communication_test_harness.measurement: Record requested and actual coverage separately; original group A is scored independently. Other groups cannot supply a missing A report even if their answers coincide.
communication_test_harness.system_boundary: This is a test condition, not the system design. Planner actions remain real generated decisions; self-execution, zero delegation and takeover are legal. Do not host-fill tasks.
